title: Stability of a safety concept vector under light fine-tuning

original_idea.body: Stability of a safety concept vector under light fine-tuning: extract from base and public fine-tuned variant, measure cosine drift. Inference-only on single GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: vector drift affects monitor staleness, but the catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses public checkpoints, inference-only extraction + cosine; motivated beginner feasible (level 5).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single comparison (drift across base vs variant) with clear success criteria (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly maintainability/safety work, addresses an explicit open problem, public checkpoints (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only extraction on existing checkpoints, single GPU (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Stated open problem but related drift studies likely exist; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Explicit open problem but vector-drift studies may already partially cover it.
